summary: Full e2e verification of the 3 new WEB browse layouts (Cinematic / Studio / Tube) + Classic + LayoutSwitcher on the RadioLife home. Backend GET /api/browse/home returns hero + 6 populated rails (originals:11, recommended:12, stations:14, podcasts:1, games:12, deals:11). All 3 skins render their required test-ids, switch instantly, persist selection to localStorage (bigfm_browse_layout) and via ?layout= param, Classic falls back to HomeRadioLife with the switcher in its header, and 'Legacy' exit flips design variant back to legacy. Verified on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile-web (390x844) viewports — no horizontal overflow on any skin; Tube chips correctly overflow horizontally (897 > 390) as expected.

issues: Many artwork URLs 404 (broken cover_image_url/logo_url in DB); the Art component falls back to gradient tiles so UX is acceptable but a lot of tiles show the fallback initial-letter block instead of imagery — cleanup recommended in seed data.

action_items: (Minor, non-blocking) React warning in console: 'A props object containing a key prop is being spread into JSX'. Not from BrowseHome/CinematicBrowse spread (props has no key) — appears in unrelated component. E1 to grep for `{...props}` where the source object contains `key` and refactor to explicit `key={...} {...rest}`.

(Content, optional) A large number of station/podcast/deal artwork URLs return 404; fallback tiles render but authored imagery would improve the 3 new pro layouts. Consider refreshing broken image URLs in channels / marketplace_profiles / podcast_channels seeds.
critical_code_review_comments: BrowseHome overlay correctly guards on variant=='radiolife' && user && layout!='classic' — matches the RCA fix. Solid.
browse.py aggregator is defensive (per-rail try/except, empty-rail filtering) — no risk of one bad collection killing the whole payload.
